Aerolite Pace 3 is a lightweight road running shoe for runners who want a neutral daily trainer that can also handle faster sessions. The outsole compound is stated as **rated to 700 km**.

- Road running and pavement use
- Daily training for runners who prefer a lighter shoe
- Tempo runs and steady-paced workouts
- Treadmill running
- Short to mid-distance runs where a lighter, firmer-feeling trainer is preferred

## Not for

competitors.title: Strider Northline Daily 2
competitors.content: Road running shoe for daily training, easy runs, and first half-marathon plans. Weight 245g (US men's 9), 8mm drop, stack 32mm heel / 24mm forefoot. Dual-density EVA/TPU blend midsole tuned for balanced cushioning rather than max softness. Engineered jacquard mesh upper with reinforced midfoot hold; better for normal to slightly wide feet than narrow racing fits. Full-contact rubber outsole with lab-tested durability to 800km and reliable wet-pavement grip. Available in men's UK 6-12 and women's UK 3-8. Price: S$189. Honest trade-off: versatile and stable, but not the snappiest option for interval days.

competitors.title: Nimbus Lane SwiftFlow 1
competitors.content: Lightweight road trainer aimed at runners who want one shoe for treadmill sessions, daily 5-10km runs, and occasional tempo work. Weight 228g (men's sample), 6mm drop, stack 30/24mm. Supercritical EVA midsole gives a quicker toe-off than standard EVA while staying approachable for beginners. Monofilament mesh upper is highly breathable for hot, humid climates. Rubber coverage placed only in high-wear zones to keep weight low; expected outsole life 500-600km. Fits true to size with a medium forefoot. Men's UK 5-13, women's UK 3-9. Price: S$199. Honest trade-off: livelier ride and lower weight, but less outsole rubber and less long-haul durability than heavier trainers.

competitors.title: Harbor Run Coastline Max
competitors.content: Cushioned daily trainer for runners prioritizing comfort over speed, especially for recovery runs, walking, and heavier runners building mileage. Weight 276g, 10mm drop, stack 38/28mm. Compression-molded EVA midsole with rocker geometry to smooth heel-to-toe transitions. Double-layer mesh upper with padded heel collar improves step-in comfort but runs warmer in tropical weather. Carbon-rubber outsole offers strong durability to around 900km. Men's UK 6-13, women's UK 4-9. Price: S$169. Honest trade-off: excellent comfort and durability for the price, but noticeably heavier and less agile for faster 5k work.

competitors.title: Vertex Relay Tempo Daily
competitors.content: Versatile performance trainer for runners who split time between steady road mileage and uptempo sessions. Weight 232g, 8mm drop, stack 34/26mm. PEBA-infused foam midsole feels more energetic than basic EVA, with a firmer platform that suits runners who dislike mushy max-cushion shoes. Open-knit upper designed for humid-weather ventilation; gusseted tongue improves lockdown for faster efforts. Durable rubber outsole rated for 650km with textured forefoot grip for damp roads. Men's UK 5-12, women's UK 3-9. Price: S$229. Honest trade-off: more responsive and workout-friendly than budget trainers, but above the S$200 cap and firmer underfoot for easy-day runners.
